row.evidence: Spinnaker is an open-source, self-hosted platform that authenticates users against the customer's OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0 or LDAP service and grants permissions only to roles from a backing role provider; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: Free open-source software with no vendor pricing page (the homepage is used as the pricing reference). Spinnaker keeps no local user directory to provision: Gate authenticates every login against the customer's IdP (OAuth 2.0/OIDC, SAML 2.0, LDAP, X.509), and Fiat assigns permissions only to roles pulled from Google Groups, GitHub org teams, LDAP or SAML/OAuth group claims, so access ends when the IdP removes the user or group. No SCIM is documented in the docs sitemap, the authentication/authorization guides or the API reference (Swagger UI on each install), so status is none by absence. Commercial distributions by third parties are not covered.

plans.name: Open source (self-hosted)
plans.notes: No paid tiers from the project; scim false = not documented.

limitations.text: SAML roles are fixed at login and cannot change until the user re-authenticates.

scim.notes: Not offered by absence; identity and roles come from the IdP and role provider at login.

user_api.notes: All API callers go through Gate; the public docs point to each install's Swagger UI and do not document user-management endpoints.

okta.notes: Docs cite Okta as the main SAML example; no catalogue app checked.

entra.notes: Homepage mentions Azure Groups for access control; no Entra setup page found.

google.notes: Google OAuth login plus Google Groups as Fiat role provider.

fallbacks.other_sync: Fiat role-provider sync (Google Groups, GitHub org teams, LDAP, SAML/OAuth group claims) periodically updates user roles
fallbacks.notes: There are no local accounts to pre-create; any user the IdP authenticates can sign in.
